evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce ICM-Bench (Identity-Centric Memory Benchmark), which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first benchmark specifically designed to evaluate identity-centric reasoning over long video memories in multimodal agents.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Existing long-video and multimodal-agent benchmarks measure broad memory question answering, but they do not isolate the ability to maintain recurring person identities and reason over their cross-time relations.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Gemini 3.1 Pro achieves the highest overall accuracy of 74.0%, yet its score falls to 60.3% on questions that require long-term identity profiles.

evidence.excerpt: We compare direct caption-memory baselines, memory-augmented agents, and graph-retrieval systems.
